Name: Understudy
Author: Tomokisan1
Description:
[size=5][b]Understudy[/b][/size]

When a villager takes a day off, their shop or post would normally just close for the day. With Understudy you can cover for them. Accept the job from the town bulletin board, work their counter for the day, and come away with a wage, a little friendship, and a look at their working life from the inside.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list]
Generic Mod Config Menu is an optional dependency. If installed, it adds a configuration screen for the mod.

[size=4][b]How it works[/b][/size]

Every so often a villager is announced as needing someone to cover their post on an upcoming day. The notice goes up on the town bulletin board a few days ahead. Walk up to the board, accept the posting, and it is added to your quest log.

On the cover day the villager stays home and their post is yours. Go to their counter during opening hours and work the shift. Customers come to be served, and you handle them at the counter. At the end of the day you are paid a wage based on how much of the shift you actually worked, plus a tip for every customer served, and you gain friendship with the villager you covered. The next morning brings a short summary and a peek into that villager's life.

The people around you notice, too. The villager you are covering, and sometimes a relative or a neighbour, mention the cover before the day, remark on it while you are working, and thank you afterwards, warmly or not, depending on how the shift went.

[size=4][b]The posts[/b][/size]

Understudy lets you cover these villagers:

[list]
[*]Pierre, at Pierre's General Store. Ring up seeds and goods. The stock follows the season, built from the crops that actually grow that season, so modded seeds are sold too.[/*]
[*]Marnie, at Marnie's Ranch. Sell animal supplies.[/*]
[*]Robin, at the Carpenter's Shop. Sell crafting materials.[/*]
[*]Willy, at the Fish Shop. Sell bait, tackle, and rods.[/*]
[*]Clint, at the Blacksmith. Customers bring geodes and you crack them open on the anvil, in a short timing mini-game. Anything the game treats as a geode works, including modded ones.[/*]
[*]Gunther, at the Museum. Villagers bring an unidentified find and you sort it into gem, mineral, or artifact. The right answer comes from the item's own data, so modded donations are handled too.[/*]
[*]Gus, at the Stardrop Saloon. The evening crowd comes to the bar to order food and drink. The customers are the real patrons already in the saloon, who get up, order, and head back to their seats.[/*]
[*]Harvey, at the Clinic. Run the reception counter and sell remedies.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Payment[/b][/size]

Your wage is based on the time you actually spend on the post during opening hours, so arriving late or leaving early earns less, and skipping the shift earns nothing. On top of the base wage you get a tip for every customer served, and friendship with the villager you covered. Doing the job well lifts both.

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

If Generic Mod Config Menu is installed, a configuration screen is available, with a general section and one section per shop:

[list]
[*]Daily Absence Chance, how likely a cover is offered on a given day.[/*]
[*]Lead Days, how far ahead a cover is announced.[/*]
[*]Max Concurrent, how many pending covers can exist at once.[/*]
[*]Customer Interval and Customer Patience, the pace at which customers arrive and how long they wait.[/*]
[*]Tip Per Customer, the tip added to your wage for each customer served.[/*]
[*]Per shop, the Base Wage and the Friendship reward, since a day at the clinic is not a day at the saloon.[/*]
[/list]
Without Generic Mod Config Menu, the same options can be edited in config.json after the first launch.

[size=4][b]Languages[/b][/size]

English, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, and Simplified Chinese.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

Understudy reads shops, crops, and geodes from the game's own data, so modded seasonal crops, modded geodes, and modded museum donations are covered without any extra setup. It is built for single player.

My mods : 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51324]Supply and Demand[/url] : Prices react to how much you sell. Flood the market with one crop and its price drops; sell little of something and it fetches a premium. Works per item on farm produce, at the shipping bin and in shops, with live tooltips, a Market Report TV channel, and GMCM support.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51314]Arcade framework[/url] : A dependency framework to plug your own minigames onto arcade cabinets, with a shared ticket wallet, high scores, and a prize booth. It provides a C# API, and a worked example that adds three playable games. Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support. Does nothing on its own.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51289]This week in Pelican Town[/url] : Turn on the TV and let the local news anchor recap your week in the valley, generated live from your own deeds. Works with other TV mods.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51294]Interactive objects framework[/url] : A modding framework that lets content packs and C# mods attach an interaction menu, with conditions, costs, cooldowns and effects, to any big craftable or furniture. Requires Content Patcher to create the objects.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26845]SWAPI - Stardew Valley Web API[/url] : Let your game send events to a custom web server.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24765]highRollerSlots[/url] : Add possibility to bet more in slots machines.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24254]geodeCrusherPlus[/url] : Add ability to geode crusher to crush any geode, including mysteryboxes, Artifact Trove and golden coconuts.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24885]﻿TV Shopping channel[/url] : ﻿Add a TV shopping channel.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24982]Prize Machine Custom Prizes[/url] : Let you easily fully customize the prize list of Prize Machine.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25022]Better Statue Of Blessings[/url]﻿ ﻿: Allow you to get one blessing by statue per day instead of only one blessing per day.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25267]Custom Blessings Framework[/url]﻿ : ﻿Allow mod developers to easily add blessings from statues of blessings.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26260]Custom Wake Up Time[/url] : Let you configure the wake up time for each day.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26371]Anti Tool Exhaustion[/url] : Prevent you to become exhausted from an accidental tool use.
